items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Me, C.O., Bates -- these are trumpeters

ctx.x: Me, C.O., Bates -- these are trumpeters -- the two trumpeters -- Bates and Weldon and Sneed and all three of them played solos. Now, the trombone was like Coker, Beckett and we had a trombone player that played on a tricky sound style. He was a hell of a muted, you know, plunger trombone player.
